dialogues.text: Attention, visitors below! Attention, visitors below! You are in water cannon range and are at risk of being hit. Please vacate the zone immediately!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Was that a warning? And did he say "water cannon"...? That doesn't sound good!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The broadcast came from over there. Let's see what's going on!
